title: 追加編：診察・薬局・通院の口語表現

items.en: Hey, Sam, the doctor asked me to come back next week.
items.jp: ねえサム、医師に来週また来るよう言われた。
items.speak: Hey, Sam, the doctor asked me to come back next week.

items.en: Did they say what the follow-up is for?
items.jp: 再診の目的は何か言ってた？
items.speak: Did they say what the follow-up is for?

items.en: I dunno. I was still processing the first part.
items.jp: 分からない。最初の説明を理解するので精いっぱいだった。
items.speak: I dunno. I was still processing the first part.
items.note: 元の形: do not know／聞こえ方: ダノウ／使う場面:分からない時

items.en: Maya, can you help me write down what to ask?
items.jp: マヤ、聞くことを書き出すのを手伝ってくれる？
items.speak: Maya, can you help me write down what to ask?

items.en: Gimme a minute; I'm finding the visit summary.
items.jp: ちょっと待って。診察のまとめを探してる。
items.speak: Give me a minute; I'm finding the visit summary.
items.note: 元の形: give me／聞こえ方: ギミ／使う場面:少し待ってもらう

items.en: The nurse said the clinic'll call if there's a cancellation.
items.jp: キャンセルが出たらクリニックから電話すると看護師さんが言ってた。
items.speak: The nurse said the clinic will call if there's a cancellation.
items.note: 元の形: clinic will／聞こえ方: クリニックゥル／使う場面:予定を伝える

items.en: Hey, doc, could you explain that in everyday terms?
items.jp: 先生、普段使う言葉で説明していただけますか？
items.speak: Hey, doc, could you explain that in everyday terms?

items.en: Sure. Stop me if anything isn't clear.
items.jp: もちろんです。分かりにくいところがあれば止めてください。
items.speak: Sure. Stop me if anything isn't clear.

items.en: I gotta check the pharmacy hours before we head out.
items.jp: 出かける前に薬局の営業時間を確認しなきゃ。
items.speak: I've got to check the pharmacy hours before we head out.
items.note: 元の形: have got to／聞こえ方: アイガラ／使う場面:必要を伝える

items.en: Hey, Jen, didja bring the insurance card?
items.jp: ねえジェン、保険証持ってきた？
items.speak: Hey, Jen, did you bring the insurance card?
items.note: 元の形: did you／聞こえ方: ディジャ／使う場面:持ち物を確認する

items.en: It's in the front pocket. I checked twice.
items.jp: 前のポケットに入ってるよ。2回確認した。
items.speak: It's in the front pocket. I checked twice.

items.en: Hey, Mom, wanna sit down before they call us?
items.jp: ねえお母さん、呼ばれる前に座る？
items.speak: Hey, Mom, want to sit down before they call us?
items.note: 元の形: want to／聞こえ方: ワナ／使う場面:気軽に誘う

items.en: Sounds good. My legs could use a break.
items.jp: いいね。ちょっと足を休めたい。
items.speak: Sounds good. My legs could use a break.

items.en: Hey, boss, I'm still sick and need to take today off.
items.jp: すみません、まだ体調が悪いので今日は休ませてください。
items.speak: Hey, boss, I'm still sick and need to take today off.

items.en: Thanks for letting me know. Focus on getting some rest.
items.jp: 知らせてくれてありがとう。ゆっくり休むことに集中して。
items.speak: Thanks for letting me know. Focus on getting some rest.

items.en: Hey, Mara, the pharmacy's out of the one they prescribed.
items.jp: ねえマラ、処方された薬の一つが薬局で在庫切れだった。
items.speak: Hey, Mara, the pharmacy is out of the one they prescribed.

items.en: Did they say when it'll be back in stock?
items.jp: いつ入荷するか聞いた？
items.speak: Did they say when it'll be back in stock?

items.en: No idea. I'll call the office and ask what they recommend.
items.jp: 分からない。診療所に電話して、どうするのがいいか聞くよ。
items.speak: No idea. I'll call the office and ask what they recommend.

items.en: Hey, Chris, can you drive me to the follow-up?
items.jp: ねえクリス、再診に車で連れていってくれる？
items.speak: Hey, Chris, can you drive me to the follow-up?

items.en: Sure. Text me the address and time.
items.jp: いいよ。住所と時間を送って。
items.speak: Sure. Text me the address and time.

items.en: Hey, pharmacist, could you go over the dosage with me?
items.jp: 薬剤師さん、服用量を一緒に確認していただけますか？
items.speak: Hey, pharmacist, could you go over the dosage with me?

items.en: Absolutely. Let's look at the label together.
items.jp: もちろんです。一緒にラベルを確認しましょう。
items.speak: Absolutely. Let's look at the label together.

items.en: Hey, Nina, I'm kinda nervous about calling the clinic.
items.jp: ねえニナ、クリニックに電話するのがちょっと不安なんだ。
items.speak: Hey, Nina, I'm kind of nervous about calling the clinic.
items.note: 元の形: kind of／聞こえ方: カインダ／使う場面:不安を控えめに話す

items.en: I can stay with you while you make the call.
items.jp: 電話している間、そばにいるよ。
items.speak: I can stay with you while you make the call.

items.en: Hey, buddy, you good? You look wiped out.
items.jp: ねえ、大丈夫？すごく疲れて見えるよ。
items.speak: Hey, buddy, are you good? You look wiped out.
items.note: 元の形: are you／聞こえ方: ユー／使う場面:様子を尋ねる

items.en: I'm okay, just need a quiet minute.
items.jp: 大丈夫。少し静かにしていたいだけ。
items.speak: I'm okay, just need a quiet minute.

items.en: Hey, Liz, did the nurse leave a message?
items.jp: ねえリズ、看護師さんから伝言あった？
items.speak: Hey, Liz, did the nurse leave a message?

items.en: Yeah, they want you to call back when you're free.
items.jp: うん、時間がある時に折り返してほしいって。
items.speak: Yeah, they want you to call back when you're free.

items.en: Hey, Alex, the appointment got moved up to ten.
items.jp: ねえアレックス、予約が10時に早まったよ。
items.speak: Hey, Alex, the appointment got moved up to ten.

items.en: Good thing you checked your messages.
items.jp: メッセージを確認しておいてよかったね。
items.speak: Good thing you checked your messages.

items.en: Hey, nurse, could you repeat the part about the next visit?
items.jp: 看護師さん、次回の受診についてもう一度言っていただけますか？
items.speak: Hey, nurse, could you repeat the part about the next visit?

items.en: Of course. I'll write it on your instructions too.
items.jp: もちろんです。指示書にも書いておきます。
items.speak: Of course. I'll write it on your instructions too.

items.en: Hey, Sam, I was gonna call earlier, but I fell asleep.
items.jp: ねえサム、もっと早く電話するつもりだったけど、寝ちゃった。
items.speak: Hey, Sam, I was going to call earlier, but I fell asleep.
items.note: 元の形: was going to／聞こえ方: ワズガナ／使う場面:予定を説明する

items.en: Don't worry. You needed the rest.
items.jp: 気にしないで。休む必要があったんだよ。
items.speak: Don't worry. You needed the rest.

items.en: Hey, folks, does anyone know where the imaging desk is?
items.jp: みなさん、画像検査の受付がどこか分かりますか？
items.speak: Hey, folks, does anyone know where the imaging desk is?

items.en: It's around the corner, next to the elevators.
items.jp: 角を曲がったところ、エレベーターの隣です。
items.speak: It's around the corner, next to the elevators.

items.en: Hey, Mom, gimme your bag. I'll carry it upstairs.
items.jp: ねえお母さん、バッグを渡して。上まで持っていくよ。
items.speak: Hey, Mom, give me your bag. I'll carry it upstairs.
items.note: 元の形: give me／聞こえ方: ギミ／使う場面:物を頼む時

items.en: Thanks. I don't wanna push it today.
items.jp: ありがとう。今日は無理したくないんだ。
items.speak: Thanks. I don't want to push it today.
items.note: 元の形: want to／聞こえ方: ワナ／使う場面:無理を避ける

items.en: Hey, doc, should I call if the pain comes back?
items.jp: 先生、痛みが戻ったら電話すべきですか？
items.speak: Hey, doc, should I call if the pain comes back?

items.en: Yes. Use the number on your visit summary.
items.jp: はい。診察内容の書類にある番号へお電話ください。
items.speak: Yes. Use the number on your visit summary.

items.en: Hey, Jen, I gotta pick up the prescription before work.
items.jp: ねえジェン、仕事の前に処方薬を受け取らなきゃ。
items.speak: Hey, Jen, I've got to pick up the prescription before work.
items.note: 元の形: have got to／聞こえ方: ガラ／使う場面:必要を伝える

items.en: I'll swing by the pharmacy with you.
items.jp: 一緒に薬局に寄るよ。
items.speak: I'll swing by the pharmacy with you.

items.en: Hey, Mara, didja hear when the results will be ready?
items.jp: ねえマラ、結果がいつ出るか聞いた？
items.speak: Hey, Mara, did you hear when the results will be ready?
items.note: 元の形: did you／聞こえ方: ディジャ／使う場面:くだけた確認

items.en: Not yet. I'll ask before we leave.
items.jp: まだ。帰る前に聞いてみるよ。
items.speak: Not yet. I'll ask before we leave.

items.en: Hey, Chris, wanna wait outside where it's quieter?
items.jp: ねえクリス、静かな外で待つ？
items.speak: Hey, Chris, want to wait outside where it's quieter?
items.note: 元の形: want to／聞こえ方: ワナ／使う場面:気軽に誘う

items.en: Sure. I'll keep my phone on in case they call.
items.jp: いいよ。電話が来るかもしれないから、電源は入れておく。
items.speak: Sure. I'll keep my phone on in case they call.

items.en: Hey, boss, I'm gonna need a little more time before I can return.
items.jp: すみません、復帰まで少し時間が必要になりそうです。
items.speak: Hey, boss, I'm going to need a little more time before I can return.
items.note: 元の形: going to／聞こえ方: ガナ／使う場面:見込みを伝える

items.en: Thanks for the update. Take care of yourself first.
items.jp: 知らせてくれてありがとう。まずは自分の体を大切にして。
items.speak: Thanks for the update. Take care of yourself first.

items.en: Hey, pharmacist, could you print the instructions in larger type?
items.jp: 薬剤師さん、説明を大きな文字で印刷していただけますか？
items.speak: Hey, pharmacist, could you print the instructions in larger type?

items.en: Sure. I'll make a new copy for you.
items.jp: もちろんです。新しいものをお作りします。
items.speak: Sure. I'll make a new copy for you.
